verdict.rationale: Deel's docs only market broad, general payroll processing ('accurate, compliant payroll... across 150+ countries') with no explicit mention of off-cycle runs, bonuses, corrections, or termination-triggered pay adjustments. A first-hand employer-side account directly contradicts the implied flexibility, stating that 'any exceptions to the rigid workflow breaks the entire process' and that customer service cannot resolve such issues. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an off-cycle/ad-hoc payroll run feature, evidence of bonus/correction/termination payroll workflows, and any corroborating success story countering the reported rigidity.
